generation.scope: For a plane-graph ternary base the marked correction space is the fifteen-dimensional Euler quotient for the identity, zero for nonidentity without a fixed line, and the three binary quadratics with scalar shift for a fixed line. All have period one. For all nonidentity plane-graph bases the unmarked classes are determined by projective conjugacy in the no-line case, or by the multiplier up to inversion, the quadratic rank and the incidence with the center of a transvection. All transvection classes are flat limits of homologies.

open_mathematics: Return to rank-fifteen AS membership. Use the full five-center quotient and graded relations over the polynomial ring in five variables to reduce the remaining high-degree ranks for ordinary bivariate inputs. Uncovered general finite and positive-dimensional windows still require a coverage proof.
